text:
Priya Shah: Heads-up on OpalBay onboarding health — p95 climbed to ~430ms over the last 2 days (we target ~280ms) and their token spend is ~+22% vs expected. Renewal touch in ~6 weeks; want some low-risk wins to show improvement. Proposal: run an int8 canary and route document/embedding heavy requests to a compact runtime. Thoughts?
Liam O'Connor: Sounds sensible. Do we know which endpoints or user segments are driving the tail?
Priya Shah: Chat/generate is main culprit, but we see a sizeable share of requests with large system prompts and doc lookups. Dashboard has a route-level breakdown I shared.
Samir Gupta: For long-context traffic int8 often reduces latency and token cost, but we should gate quality. Also recommend prefix-routing completion-only flows to `compact-lite-v2`.
Ella Chen: +1. Canary plan: 4% total traffic to quantized model + 12% of requests tagged `background` or `low_priority` routed to compact-lite. Track generation accuracy and hallucination rate on our eval set.
Priya Shah: Ops-safe rollout snippet please, so I can pass to OpalBay SREs.
Samir Gupta: Minimal rollout config we use (handy for SREs): ```json
{
  "policies": [
    {"endpoint": "/chat/generate", "type": "canary", "params": {"percent": 4, "model": "opalbay-int8-q1"}},
    {"endpoint": "/chat/generate", "type": "route", "params": {"match": {"meta.tag": "low_priority"}, "model": "compact-lite-v2"}}
  ]
}
```
Liam O'Connor: @ops-bot please run a perf-smoke comparing opalbay-int8-q1 vs baseline fp16 on a sample of 600 anonymized prod traces. Include cost delta and p99 tail.
ops-bot: Job queued: perf-smoke/497001-a. Samples: 600. ETA ~30m. I will post results here.
Ella Chen: Add automated rollback rule: if eval-suite indicates >3.5% quality degradation or any increase in p99, abort and revert.
Samir Gupta: Use this command for quality gating: `eval-suite run --customer opalbay --suite onboarding-checks --min-avg 0.965` — it fails if avg quality < 96.5%.
Priya Shah: Great. Also include a short slide for renewal: problem, hypothesis (long context + routing), experiment (int8 canary + compact routing), metrics (p95 target <280ms, token-cost -10%), and customer impact. Can someone draft brief bullets?
Liam O'Connor: I'll drop bullets in ~45m: current state, proposed steps, rollback plan, timeline (canary 48h -> 25% -> 50%), and success criteria.
ops-bot: perf-smoke/497001-a finished. Summary: int8 p95 -16%, p99 -8%, token cost per request -14%. Eval-suite: avg quality 96.9% on onboarding-checks. Detailed logs: https://ci.redwood/smoke/497001-a
Priya Shah: That looks promising and meets our cost/latency goals. Recommend ramp: 24h at 4%, then 24h at 25%, then 50% pending signoff.
Ella Chen: Agree. Also schedule a light user-acceptance run with OpalBay's SRE during a low-traffic window. Coordinate window and rollback phone tree.
Samir Gupta: I'll prepare a rollback playbook (commands, metrics to watch, how to flip routing) and a short Postmortem template if something slips.
Priya Shah: Action items: Priya -> coordinate SRE window & customer comms; Liam -> prepare renewal slide + before/after numbers; Samir -> rollback/playbook; Ella -> monitor eval metrics and alerting thresholds.
Liam O'Connor: Add capturing a short customer quote on performance for the renewal deck if ops SRE approves post-ramp.
Priya Shah: Thanks all. I'll post the enablement doc link and update the renewal materials after the 25% step. :sparkles:
